maria: quick flag 12 - hit an edge-case with rollback after using the scope editor's dry-run preview.

aditya: what's the symptom?

maria: when you preview (dry-run) and later apply then immediately rollback, the PATCH payload sent by the console omits explicit quota/scope flags. routing treats those as dropped and falls back to low-cost models.

sam: oof. repro steps?

maria: 1) create role binding with scope=restricted and quota_override=true
2) canary to 5% with dry-run enabled (UI preview only)
3) flip canary off, click rollback on the binding
4) router logs: `missing_scope=true` for tenant -> traffic moved to fallback model

kevin: looks like frontend intentionally strips falsy flags to keep payload small. rollback flow expects full state.

aditya: confirmed. console was leaving out `quota_override` when falsey. authz historically treats absent keys as "preserve existing" but our rollback path is doing a replace.

sam: will adding explicit false be safe? older authz checked `X-Route-Quota: preserve` header. compatibility needed.

aditya: plan: frontend always ship an `explicit_flags` map in PATCH/rollback with booleans; also include `X-Perm-Digest` header (sha1 of canonical flags) so backend can detect intention. backend: if digest present, perform replace; otherwise preserve missing keys.

maria: also propose telemetry: event `perm.rollback.preview_applied` sampled 1% with fields: `route_count:int`, `quota_override:bool`, `perm_diff_hash` (compact).

kevin: +1. include an on-screen banner in rollback modal: "Rolling back will also restore route quota flags. Review changes." small CTA -> diff.

sam: I'll add a Grafana alert: query `router.events{missing_scope="true",env="$env"}` grouped by tenant; fire if count > 4 in 5m.

aditya: timeline: frontend PR today (small change), backend compatibility shim tomorrow, telemetry + UI copy this sprint. Tests: add unit for authz replace vs preserve, and console e2e for dry-run->rollback path.

maria: follow-ups: @kevin add console e2e in `console-integration`; @sam add dashboard alert and an alert runbook stub. I'll update rollout checklist with "rollback dry-run flag" item.

rbac-bot: auto-note: incident created /incidents/perm-dryrun-rollback-edgecase tag=perm-rollback-risk; escalation=eng-platform

aditya: I'll post PR links here when ready. thanks all.
